questions.question:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

A. The train B. had left the station C. before we D. had arrived.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**had arrived**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses two actions in the past: 

 
 
• The train leaving the station happened first.
 
• Our arrival happened later.
 
 
 
• The action that happened first should be in **past perfect tense** ("had left"), while the later action should be in **simple past tense**.
 
• Therefore, "**had arrived**" is incorrect and should be replaced with "**arrived**".
 
• Hence, the grammatical error is in **Part D**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The train had left the station before we **arrived**__."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Past perfect tense is used for the action completed earlier in the past.
 
• Simple past tense is generally used for the later past action.
 
• Example: "She had eaten before I arrived."

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate idiom:

After months of subtle manipulation, she finally showed her true colors and ______.

options.text: took the bull by the horns

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"stabbed him in the back"** means to betray someone who trusts you. (पीठ में छुरा घोंपना)

 
 
• **Example:** She trusted her colleague, but he stabbed her in the back by taking credit for her work.
 

 
• **"Showed her true colors"** means to reveal one's real personality or intentions, often negative ones. (असली रूप दिखाना)

 
 
• **Example:** After months of pretending to be kind, she finally showed her true colors and betrayed her friends.
 

 
• The sentence implies that the person pretended for months but eventually betrayed someone. Hence, "stabbed him in the back" fits best.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Played her cards right** (अपने पत्ते सही से खेलना): To act cleverly and make the right decisions to achieve success. (समझदारी से काम लेना)
 
 
• **Example:** If you play your cards right, you might get promoted soon.
 

 
• **Option 3: Took the bull by the horns** (सांड को सींग से पकड़ना): To face a difficult situation directly and with courage. (किसी मुश्किल स्थिति का साहस के साथ सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of avoiding the issue, he took the bull by the horns and resolved it.
 

 
• **Option 4: Burned the midnight oil** (आधी रात तक काम करना): To work late into the night, usually studying or working hard. (रात देर तक काम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She burned the midnight oil to prepare for her final exams.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **Fastidious**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Meticulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Fastidious"** means showing or demanding excessive care or attention to detail; being very particular and hard to please. (अत्यधिक चुस्त, सूक्ष्म और कठिन-से-प्रसन्न)
 
 
• **Example:** She was fastidious about the cleanliness of her home, making sure every corner was spotless.

• **Example:** The artist was meticulous in his work, spending hours perfecting every detail of the painting.
 

 
• Since both "Fastidious" and "Meticulous" emphasize attention to detail and care, **"Meticulous"** is the correct synonym for **"Fastidious"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Meticulous**.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of graphic design according to the text?

options.text: To communicate a specific message or concept through visuals

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2: ****To communicate a specific message or concept through visuals**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary purpose of graphic design is to **communicate a specific message or concept through visuals**, making it a powerful tool for effective communication.
 
• While aesthetics are important, the focus of graphic design lies in delivering the intended message clearly and effectively.
 
• Design choices such as color, typography, and layout are made to support the message or idea being conveyed.
 
• Thus, the main goal of graphic design is not just to make designs look modern or follow trends, but to ensure that the message is communicated in a visually engaging and impactful way.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** Graphic design is a discipline that blends creativity and purpose. The design elements are intentionally chosen to communicate specific ideas, messages, or emotions to the target audience, ensuring clarity and engagement.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Creating aesthetically pleasing visuals is a part of graphic design, but it is secondary to the primary purpose of communication.
 
• **Option 3:** Making designs look modern is not the primary goal of graphic design; it is merely a style choice.
 
• **Option 4:** Following industry trends can enhance a design's relevance but is not the main objective of graphic design.

questions.question: Which of the following elements are combined by graphic designers to create visual messages?

options.text: Color, design software, videos, and typography

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1: ****Typography, color, images, and layout.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Graphic designers combine various elements to create visually appealing and effective messages.
 
• These elements include **typography, color, images, and layout**, which are essential for designing visual communication.
 
• Typography involves the style and arrangement of text to make it readable and visually engaging.
 
• Color is used to evoke emotions, create emphasis, and establish a visual hierarchy.
 
• Images, including illustrations and photography, add visual interest and convey meaning.
 
• The layout organizes these elements cohesively to guide the viewer's attention and ensure clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** *Graphic designers use typography, color, images, and layout to effectively communicate ideas and messages visually.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** While videos, music, and text are used in multimedia design, they are not the primary elements of graphic design.
 
• **Option 3:** Design software is a tool for creating designs, but it is not an element of graphic design itself.
 
• **Option 4:** Photography, videos, and music are relevant to multimedia but do not encompass all essential elements of graphic design.

questions.question: How is graphic design utilized in our everyday lives?

options.text: To entertain audiences and promote entertainment services
To create visual appeal without any specific function
To influence understanding, marketing, and branding
To only improve the aesthetic quality of spaces and products

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3: ****To influence understanding, marketing, and branding**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• Graphic design is a powerful tool used to influence understanding, marketing, and branding in everyday life. 
 
• It helps in creating visually compelling messages that convey ideas and information effectively. 
 
• Through logos, advertisements, product packaging, and digital content, graphic design plays a vital role in shaping consumer perceptions and behaviors. 
 
• It connects businesses with their audiences by building a strong and recognizable brand identity. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** * Graphic design is not just about aesthetics; it involves strategic visual communication to achieve specific goals such as marketing, branding, and influencing understanding. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 1:** While graphic design is used to entertain audiences and promote entertainment services, this is only one of its many applications. 
 
• **Option 2:** Creating visual appeal without any specific function is not the primary purpose of graphic design. It is inherently functional and goal-oriented. 
 
• **Option 4:** Improving aesthetic quality is a part of graphic design, but its scope extends far beyond just aesthetics.

Ability to write compelling texts, manage teams, and learn new technologies

Expertise in advanced software coding and web development

• Good comprehension of design principles, such as balance, contrast, alignment, and hierarchy, is critical for creating visually appealing work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ **

• **Option 3:** Knowledge of web coding, photography, and motion graphics is useful for specialized roles but not essential for all graphic designers. 
 
• **Option 4:** Advanced software coding and web development fall outside the primary scope of graphic design.

questions.question: What does the job of a graphic designer fundamentally involve?

options.text: Combining creativity with visual communication to address real-world problems
Creating new art for art’s sake and pursuing personal expression
Organizing visuals for simplicity and clarity in minimalistic designs
Following a set of predefined design rules without deviation

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1: ****Combining creativity with visual communication to address real-world problems.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The job of a graphic designer fundamentally involves **combining creativity with visual communication** to address real-world problems.
 
• This means using design principles, tools, and skills to create visuals that effectively communicate ideas and solve specific challenges.
 
• Option 2 (**Creating new art for art's sake**) is incorrect because graphic design is purpose-driven and not solely about personal expression.
 
• Option 3 (**Organizing visuals for minimalistic designs**) is a subset of graphic design but does not encompass its broader scope.
 
• Option 4 (**Following predefined rules**) is incorrect because graphic design often requires flexibility and innovation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** *Graphic design is a discipline that blends creativity with strategic visual communication to solve problems and convey messages effectively across various mediums.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Creativity:** Graphic designers use their creative abilities to craft visually appealing and effective designs.
 
• **Purpose-driven:** Unlike art for personal expression, graphic design focuses on addressing specific communication goals and problems.
 
• **Tools and Skills:** Designers use software like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma to create their work.
 
• **Flexibility:** While design principles exist, graphic designers often need to adapt and innovate based on project requirements.

questions.question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

Why had the highly sensitive company report been rejected by the board of directors?

options.text: Why had the board of directors rejected the highly sensitive company report?
Why the board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report?
The board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report, why?
Why did the board of directors reject the highly sensitive company report?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• Active voice structure: The subject of the sentence performs the action on the object.
 
• In the given passive sentence: "Why had the highly sensitive company report been rejected by the board of directors?"
 
• To convert this into active voice, the subject "the board of directors" must perform the action "rejected" on the object "the highly sensitive company report."
 
• The correct active voice sentence is: "Why had the board of directors rejected the highly sensitive company report?"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Why had the board of directors rejected the highly sensitive company report?"*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Why the board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report?" – Incorrect word order.
 
• **Option 3: **"The board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report, why?" – Incorrect structure and punctuation.
 
• **Option 4: **"Why did the board of directors reject the highly sensitive company report?" – Incorrect tense (simple past instead of past perfect).

questions.question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The chef had prepared the special dish.

options.text: The special dish was prepared by the chef.
The special dish had been prepared by the chef.
The special dish has been prepared by the chef.
The special dish is being prepared by the chef.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The chef had prepared the special dish."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the special dish" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had prepared" to "had been prepared" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the chef."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The special dish had been prepared by the chef."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The special dish was prepared by the chef." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The special dish has been prepared by the chef." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The special dish is being prepared by the chef." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).

questions.question:
**Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:**

P. It soon became a very important tool for long-distance information communication.

Q. The invention of the telegraph was one of the most remarkable technological advances of the 19th century.

R. In linking cities and even continents with its cable and signal networks, it transformed the rhythm of life.

S. This rate of communication had a revolutionary effect on the conduct of politics, business, and warfare.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins with Sentence Q as it introduces the invention of the telegraph and its significance in history. 
 
• **Sentence Q is the first sentence** because it sets the context for the importance of the telegraph: 
 
 
• "The invention of the telegraph was one of the most remarkable technological advances of the 19th century." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence P follows** as it explains how the telegraph became important for long-distance communication: 
 
 
• "It soon became a very important tool for long-distance information communication." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence R comes next** because it describes how the telegraph connected cities and continents, influencing daily life: 
 
 
• "In linking cities and even continents with its cable and signal networks, it transformed the rhythm of life." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence S concludes** by elaborating on how the telegraph revolutionized politics, business, and warfare: 
 
 
• "This rate of communication had a revolutionary effect on the conduct of politics, business, and warfare." 
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **Q, P, R, S**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The invention of the telegraph was one of the most remarkable technological advances of the 19th century. It soon became a very important tool for long-distance information communication. In linking cities and even continents with its cable and signal networks, it transformed the rhythm of life. This rate of communication had a revolutionary effect on the conduct of politics, business, and warfare."</div
